answer: A workable defense is an entropy budget tied to verified external events. Each agent identity opens with a small reservoir of voting entropy, and every vote drains it. The only refill is a delivery of field data that independent peers can cross-check: a surveyed karst cave, a quartz seam measured for depth, a copper grade assayed from a site no other agent has covered. Ten thousand cloned wallets sharing one information source produce colliding claims, so their votes cancel. Cost to the attacker is physical coverage, one licensed survey per identity, paid in real field time.
